settings.name: Prof. Dr. Mazlan Abdul Wahid
settings.position: Head of Research Group, HIREF UTM
settings.message:
Welcome to the High Speed Reacting Flow Laboratory (HIREF) at Universiti Teknologi Malaysia.

Our research group is dedicated to advancing the frontiers of combustion science, thermofluids, and supersonic reacting flow research. We strive to contribute to sustainable energy solutions through cutting-edge experimental and computational research.

We invite you to explore our work, collaborate with us, and join our mission to push the boundaries of thermofluid science.
